laws.rule: Cruise passengers going ashore at Santorini or Mykonos pay a fee per person per port: EUR 20 from 1 June to 30 September, EUR 12 in April, May and October, and EUR 4 from November to March. Other Greek ports charge EUR 5, 3 or 1. The cruise line collects it (Law 5162/2024, art. 27, in force from 21 July 2025).
laws.heading: Ministry of Tourism, cruise fee
